title: Coverage-Age Allowance Rate Card for the Same-Visit Courtesy, Workmanship Warranties
content:
**Rate card.** Under the Workmanship Warranties, a same-visit coverage-age allowance is added into the same-visit courtesy sum on a Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty or Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty. The same-visit coverage-age allowance follows the whole calendar months from the coverage's issued date to the courtesy date:

| Whole calendar months from issued date to courtesy date | Same-visit coverage-age allowance |
|---|---|
| fewer than the young-coverage months, 24 | the young-coverage allowance, USD 3.00 |
| 24 or more, but fewer than the middle-coverage months, 48 | the middle-coverage allowance, USD 1.50 |
| 48 or more | none |

## Boundary readings (hypothetical ages)

| Months | Allowance |
|---|---|
| 23 | USD 3.00 |
| 24 | USD 1.50 |
| 47 | USD 1.50 |
| 48 | none |

The months are counted from the issued date recorded on the coverage to the date the courtesy is figured.
